title: Catseye
body:
Description

For the 2025 Halloween event, Catseye can only spawn at the Monstrous Manor in smokeslate nodes for,

Catseye in all its forms can be used for schematics.

Trivia

  • The ore has a small sparkle effect
  • When refined, is slightly transparent
  • "Cat's Eye" in real life is known as Cymophane, which is a type of Chrysoberyl (BeAl₂O₄) but with chatoyancy.
